The guitar pattern uses a steady alternating bass note on beats 1 and 3 with syncopated treble plucks. A second acoustic guitar enters with high-register melodic counterpoint. Subtle room reverb is applied to the vocals and guitars. The arrangement remains sparse without percussion or bass guitar. The vocal delivery is intimate and close-mic'd, emphasizing breath sounds and consonant articulation. The song follows a 4/4 time signature throughout.

bass.tags: Industrial techno with heavy distortion and mechanical textures. A distorted kick drum with a long, saturated sub-tail provides the rhythmic core at 130 BPM in the key of F minor. A metallic, resonant percussion loop with high-pass filtering and short delay repeats every bar. A low-frequency sawtooth synth drone fluctuates with a slow LFO on the cutoff frequency. Gritty, white-noise-based risers occur every eight bars. The mix is heavily compressed with a pumping sidechain effect triggered by the kick drum. High-frequency industrial clangs with heavy reverb appear on the off-beats. A bitcrushed synth lead enters with a syncopated, three-note rhythmic pattern.
